verifications.claim: The 2026 Men's NCAA Final Four will be held at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, Indiana.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis" (R1, R2, R3); "Final Four April 4 & 6 Indianapolis Lucas Oil Stadium" (R5); "Final Four: Saturday, April 4 at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state the location as Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis for the 2026 Men's Final Four.

verifications.claim: Games of the 2026 Men's NCAA Final Four will occur on April 4 and April 6, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Saturday, April 4, 2026, at 8:54 p.m. ET... Monday, April 6" (R1); "Final Four: April 4 & 6... NCAA championship game: 8:30 p.m. ET on Monday, April 6" (R5, R7)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly list semifinals on April 4 and championship on April 6.
